subject: Quality checks before furniture leaves the workshop
hook: Cutting list in, labelled parts out: where the checks happen along the way.
ig:
Cutting list in, labelled parts out: where the checks happen along the way.

Here's how a typical trade order moves through our Hanley workshop:

1. We read your cutting list first and query anything unclear, like grain direction or which edges get banding.
2. Cut on the sliding table panel saw, measured as each part comes off.
3. Edged with ABS at the thickness you've specified, then checked.
4. Drilled on the multi-spindle boring machine and checked against the drawing.
5. Assembled if you've ordered carcasses, then squared by the diagonals.
6. Labelled to your list and wrapped.

Checking at each stage, rather than only at the end, means a problem is caught at the machine that caused it.

Got a job coming up? DM us your cutting list and we'll come back with a priced quote.
fb:

We read it properly first and ask questions early. Then each part is cut, edged, drilled and, if you've ordered it, assembled, with a check after every stage, before it's all labelled to your list and wrapped for collection.

Trade and domestic orders welcome. Have a look at our trade services and send us your list.

alt: Six-frame carousel: a printed cutting list, a panel saw, an edge bander, a boring machine, an assembled carcass, and labelled wrapped panels.
on_asset:
F1: Cutting list in — We read it before cutting: board, sizes, grain direction, edges to band and drilling. Questions get asked now, not after. |
F2: Cut — Panels cut on the sliding table panel saw and measured against the list as they come off. |
F3: Edge — ABS edging applied at the agreed thickness, then checked for bond, trim and clean corners. |
F4: Drill — Hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowels drilled on the boring machine and checked against the drawing. |
F5: Assemble (if ordered) — Cabinets built and checked square by their diagonals. |
F6: Label and wrap — Each part labelled to your list and wrapped for collection, or delivery quoted per job. |
